title: Payment Arrangements Installment Billed on Each Bill: Method of Reckoning
content:
**Billing standard — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): the installment billed on a bill**

**(1) Installment scheduled.** The installment scheduled is the agreement's installment amount, never more than the unbilled balance; where the installment being billed is the last of the installment count, it is the whole unbilled balance. The unbilled balance is the amount moved into the agreement less every installment already billed and every amount already billed back, as the agreement's ledger records them before this bill.

**(2) Previous bill.** The previous bill is the bill that carried the latest installment already billed on the agreement. The charges it required are its usage lines and that installment.

**(3) Credited toward the previous bill.** The payments credited toward the previous bill are the payments posted to the service account in the month ending on the bill date, as posted. No energy assistance pledge counts toward the previous bill.

**(4) Payment above the previous bill.** The payment above the previous bill is what was credited toward the previous bill less the charges it required, never below zero. A payment above what the previous bill required is applied in full to the installment being billed.

**(5) Installment billed.** The installment billed is the installment scheduled less the payment above the previous bill that is applied to it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figure (hypothetical agreement: installment amount $75.00, count of 3)**

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| moved into the agreement | $225.00 |
| installment 1 already billed | $75.00 |
| unbilled balance before this bill | $150.00 |
| installment scheduled (installment 2, not the last) | $75.00 |
| previous bill required: usage lines $92.40 plus installment 1 $75.00 | $167.40 |
| payments posted in the month ending on the bill date | $200.00 |
| payment above the previous bill | $32.60 |
| installment billed: $75.00 less $32.60 | $42.40 |

**Last installment (same hypothetical agreement)** — after installments of $75.00 and $42.40 the unbilled balance is $107.60; installment 3 is the last of the count, so the installment scheduled is the whole $107.60 rather than $75.00.
